verdict.rationale: Vue documentation includes a dedicated 'Error Reference' page, implying some structured guidance on runtime/compile errors, but the evidence pack provides no detail on dev-server error overlays, actionable stack traces, or build-tool error messaging (e.g., Vite integration specifics).
